overview: Shramik is a professional platform connecting daily wage workers across 35+ professions with people seeking their services. Features GPS-based worker discovery, multi-language support (Hindi, English, Marathi), a complete admin dashboard, and a full Vercel deployment guide for self-hosting with Node.js and MongoDB.
features: Worker registration with 3-step form, photo upload, and extended profile fields
Admin dashboard with approval, rejection, ban, and real-time stats
GPS-based map showing nearby verified workers with profession and distance filters
Multi-language support: English, Hindi, and Marathi
Worker login, logout banner, availability toggle, and profile editing
Full /deploy-guide page with step-by-step GitHub + Vercel deployment instructions
